biggest_disagreements.proposal:
<text>
The client wants a fraud detection model and an invoice OCR and extraction pipeline for a logistics company. I designed and delivered a fraud detection model using Python and XGBoost for an edtech company, catching 81% of fraudulent transactions with a 0.4% false‑positive rate. I also designed and delivered an invoice OCR and extraction pipeline using Tesseract and LayoutLM for a healthcare company, extracting line items with 97% field accuracy on 5,000 invoices. Both solutions used anomaly detection and Python for heavy lifting and were integrated into the client’s existing systems. The fraud model identified suspicious transactions before they were processed, and the OCR pipeline accurately extracted numeric data from scanned invoices, meeting the success measures agreed with the client.
</text>
